result.topic_en: A list of six formulas relating the sides and angles of a right-angled spherical triangle, with a labelled diagram.
result.transcription:
Rechtwinklige Dreiecke
[diagram: spherical triangle with vertices F, G and a right angle marked 90°; sides h (opposite the right angle), f (opposite F), g (opposite G)]
I. $\cos h = \cos f . \cos g$ .
II. $\cos h . \mathrm{tang}\, F . \mathrm{tang}\, G = 1$ .
III. $\sin h . \sin F = \sin f$ .
IV. $\mathrm{tang}\, h . \cos F = \mathrm{tang}\, g$ .
V. $\mathrm{tang}\, F . \sin g = \mathrm{tang}\, f$ .
VI. $\sin F . \cos g = \cos G$

methods.what: Spherical Pythagorean theorem for a right spherical triangle (cosine of the hypotenuse equals the product of the cosines of the legs)
Napier's rule relating the hypotenuse to the two oblique angles: cos c = cot A cot B
Napier's rule: sine of a leg equals sine of the hypotenuse times sine of the opposite angle
Napier's rule: tangent of the adjacent leg equals tangent of the hypotenuse times cosine of the angle
Napier's rule: tangent of the opposite leg equals tangent of the angle times sine of the adjacent leg
Napier's rule: cosine of one oblique angle equals sine of the other angle times cosine of the opposite leg
